# QuickPOS

> QuickPOS is retail point of sale (POS) software for shops, supermarkets, boutiques, and growing retail stores in Nigeria and worldwide. It connects checkout, barcode scanning, inventory, staff roles, customers, receipts, and sales reports in one system, with installed apps for Windows, Android, macOS, and Linux and an offline sales queue for connection interruptions. QuickPOS is operated by SIRDAVID MULTI-TRADE LTD (RC 9387137), Nigeria.

Key facts:

- QuickPOS is POS software, not a bank payment terminal ("POS machine"). It records each sale and its payment method (cash, card, transfer, or mobile) alongside the store's own payment terminal or bank account.
- Pricing (one store, all features, unlimited staff): ₦20,000 (US$15 outside Nigeria) activation covering the first five months, then ₦5,000 / $4 monthly, ₦13,500 / $10 quarterly, or ₦50,000 / $38 yearly.
- Platforms: Windows 10 or later (64-bit), Android 8 or later, macOS (Intel and Apple silicon), and 64-bit Linux. Installers are downloaded from the QuickPOS account portal after activation.
- Barcode scanning with a device camera or USB/Bluetooth scanners.
- Offline: after an online sync, supported sales continue during a connection interruption and synchronize when the connection returns; a verified subscription works offline for up to seven days.
- Staff roles: admin, manager, and cashier.
- Reports: revenue, orders, discounts, tax, top products, and cashier and payment records, with PDF, Excel, and CSV exports and emailed store statements.
- Current limits: one store per subscription; no batch or expiry-date tracking; no size/colour variants (each size or colour is created as its own product); sales are recorded in whole units.
- Support: support@quickpos.com.ng or https://quickpos.com.ng/support
